set.body: From Claude independent review of lexical bd-01M381YHAXMH9F5HZD8P7DKTBX at SHA a71a3ad9. ContentLexicalSuite test named typed lexical scoring agrees with historical provider now compares the typed scorer against its own Source shim, so it is a regression guard rather than an independent parity control. Rename or replace it to state its actual proof burden; retain the literal Jaccard grid, which killed L1 and L2. This is FOLLOW-UP, not a landing block, and should wait for the integrated slice to land.
set.title: Clarify lexical parity test proof burden
